verdict.rationale: LiteLLM's Router load-balances traffic across multiple deployments, such as Azure/OpenAI. It also offers request prioritization (queueing), cooldowns, retries with fixed and exponential backoff, and per-team rpm_limit throttling. Together these cover the core of smoothing provider rate limits. Missing for 10: explicit docs on spreading load across multiple API keys for the same provider and on rate-limit-aware (TPM/RPM-based) routing, detail on how the queue behaves, and independent hands-on corroboration.
